## Scope of work

- BOM PDFs include a bulleted, extractive scope summary. JSON exports retain the
  full scope and the summary. Check the original scope for all requirements,
  qualifications and exclusions.
- When a job has no scope file, the app prepares a draft based on possible P&ID
  notes and identified items. Review and edit the draft before approving it;
  approval saves it to the job's scope folder and the desktop app then rescans.
- API clients can retrieve and approve the draft using the job scope-draft
  endpoints, then rescan the job.

Drawing notes and items are evidence, not proof of authorized work. Verify the
proposed scope against the P&ID; image-only drawings may require manual entry.
Standard Windows and macOS downloads do not bundle Tesseract OCR.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.20...v0.1.21
